==Description==
This template is used for creating the blue "archive box" used for closed [[Forum:Senate Hall|Senate Hall]] threads.

==Usage==
The template takes one optional signature parameter. Place only one of the following lines of code at the top of the vote page to be archived:
<pre>
{{subst:SHarchive|~~~~}}
</pre>
<pre>
{{subst:SHarchive}} ~~~~
</pre>

Then, to avoid disrupting the page layout, add this closing tag at the very end of the thread:
<pre>
</div>
</pre>

[[Category:Archive templates]]</noinclude>
